data.title: [HatSubs] One Piece 1169-1180 (WEB 1080p)
data.description:
Translation: Official
Editing: Notkama
Translation check, Timing, Typesetting: Giraffebirbyuimumei
Quality check: Toto, Gyro
Song Translation: bluesun

![NEP ECE](https://i.postimg.cc/NfNfYJm9/OP1169-1180.png)

[Patch for the v1s](https://mega.nz/file/Ud42VbbQ#JWZR7Ds0K1KTVj07kcYDHEYdEbNUsLmukgS9Aj86mis)

Batch for the second half of this year's One Piece run. Almost every episode is v2'd, though mostly it's due to small tweaks here and there. There's only one REALLY BIG change made:
We realized that Scopper Gaban should be Scopper Gabin. Oda has confirmed that he's named after the actor Jean Gabin, whose name is spelled in Japan as ギャバン, exactly the same as the One Piece character. So, Scopper Gabin he shall be.

To avoid running into problems playing any of our releases, [please use mpv!](https://iamscum.wordpress.com/guides/videoplayback-guide/)
